name: Qiwen Mini Pet Car Dashboard Decorations
shortDescription: A cute mini pet figurine set for adding kawaii puppy-and-kitty charm to a car dashboard, rearview mirror area, shelf, or tiny desk display.
longDescription: This Qiwen mini pet car decoration set is a sweet little upgrade for anyone who likes cute details in everyday spaces. The listing images show tiny puppy and cat-style figurines arranged on car dashboards and near rearview mirror areas, with a mix of sitting and lying poses that feel playful without taking up much room. The pieces can also work as tiny desk, shelf, monitor, or miniature-room decorations if you prefer to keep them outside the car. They are best treated as small decorative accents rather than toys. Before buying, check the current Amazon listing for the exact pieces included, material, adhesive or placement method, size, and safe placement guidance for your car interior.
